summary.text: Ray Lopez represents Texas House District 125, covering much of San Antonio's West and Northwest Sides, after being elected to the 86th Legislature on March 12, 2019. His official biography names Defense and Veterans' Affairs and Juvenile Justice and Family Issues among his committees for the 86th Legislature.

paragraphs.text: Lopez is a graduate of Harlandale High School and served 14 years in the Army Reserve after high school.
He is a retired AT&T executive with over 35 years of experience in the information and telecommunications industry, and was also a small business owner.
In 1990 he was elected to the North Side Independent School District Board of Trustees, where he served as Board President.
In 2004 he was elected to the San Antonio City Council, representing Council District 6 for four consecutive terms until reaching his term limit.
He and his wife, Evelyn, have four grown children.
